card.tagline: European variation of swing dance often done competitively that developed in the 1940s
card.profile: Boogie-woogie dance is a European variation of swing dance often done competitively that developed in the 1940s. Although its name derives from the boogie-woogie genre of music, it is most often danced to rock music. The form is cited in Madonna's hit single "Music".
